core_meaning.primary_meaning: Naji is an Arabic-origin name meaning “One who is saved, survivor”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Naji corresponds to the Arabic form نَاجِي (Arabic root ن ج و (n-j-w); نَاجِي (Nājī)). Its core sense is naji; one who is saved, survivor. Naji is Arabic نَاجِي (Nājī) 'one who is saved, survivor', from the root ن ج و (n-j-w). The source gloss 'Intelligent, Wise' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as najee.

faq.q: What is the root of Naji?
faq.a: It is built on the root ن ج و (n-j-w).

faq.a: Documented usage records Naji as a boy's name; actual use can vary by community.
